objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation and consecutive number identifying the document (e.g. RL_0001).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document, incremented upon revision or changes.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version of the document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document is valid, calculated from Valid From plus period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Time period for validity check, default 3 years per document type.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents are retained before physical deletion, default 10 years.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language of the document content.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Areas of validity or relevant companies for the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents, master data, or IT applications.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications referenced by the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or areas for which the document is valid.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document attached to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment, following the main document release process.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary document attached to a main document that is not subject to the release cycle and can be published directly via property switches.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Published or unpublished status of the additional information.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for changing an existing released document, managed separately without affecting the document content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, triggering a workflow to check and extend validity.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the validity extension request.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a document and withdraw it from circulation, triggering an archiving workflow.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the override request.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document, restoring its validity and authorizations.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the reactivation request.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A group of users defined in the system for assigning read, write, or acknowledgement authorizations to documents.

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Name of the user group (e.g. Reader - Document Management, Authors, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive).

objs.name: person
objs.description: An individual user in the system who can be assigned roles and authorizations on documents.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to the person (e.g. Author, Co-Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator, Reader).

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and persons assigned to a document for email notification or acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by email or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A workflow instance supporting the release, validity extension, override, reactivation, or acknowledgement process.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (e.g. release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement, translation release).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the workflow.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signature provided by a workflow participant to confirm completion of a workflow step.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: Person who provided the signature.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Workflow step in which the signature was provided (e.g. Creator, Review, Release).

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document is created in the system by attaching a new information object with selection of the corresponding document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The type of document being created.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: The template selected for the new document, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the implemented editing client in the corresponding Office component.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: The properties and metadata of a document are maintained, including standardized and customer-specific attributes.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: The document is automatically and system-supported converted to PDF after saving.

evts.name: assign_authorizations
evts.description: Read and write authorizations are assigned to the document by defining user groups and persons for reader, author, co-author, reviewer, and releaser roles.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is created and linked to a main document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving, triggering a new version of the main document upon its next release.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is created and added to a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: modify_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is modified without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is deleted from a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing released document by a user with author rights.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is documented as completed by the author of the underlying document.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step release workflow (Creator - Review - Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the Creator step of the release workflow with an electronic signature.

evts.name: sign_review_step
evts.description: A reviewer signs the Review step of the release workflow after checking the document for technical and formal aspects.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Type of review performed (technical or formal).

evts.name: reject_review_step
evts.description: A reviewer rejects the document during the Review step, canceling the workflow for all subsequent participants.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason for rejection provided by the reviewer.

evts.name: sign_release_step
evts.description: A releaser signs the Release step of the release workflow, finalizing the document release.

evts.name: reject_release_step
evts.description: A releaser rejects the document during the Release step, canceling the workflow for all subsequent participants.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason for rejection provided by the releaser.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: The document is released and automatically published, becoming visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created for revision, retaining all data from the previous version.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The new version number.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the document validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The validity of a document is extended by declaring additional validity, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A request for override (invalidation) is created for a document by a user with write access.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: A document is declared out of force, revoking all rights except for the archive group and starting the archive duration.

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: An archived document is physically deleted after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A request for reactivation is created by the Business Admin group for a previously invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document is reactivated, creating a new version with restored metadata, authorizations, distribution list, and attachments.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are informed by email notification when a new document version is released.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are requested by email to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a released document version via a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system sends an email notification to inform users about workflow tasks, status changes, or other document events.

attributes.name: notification_type
attributes.description: Type of notification (e.g. workflow task, validity extension, override, change proposal).

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language by a translator.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated language version of a document is checked and released via workflow, making it visible to readers in the corresponding login language.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language of the released translation.
